results.recovery_checks: passed: HTTP cancel, rejected request, changed reference

stress_validation.interpretation: 20 consecutive syntheses succeeded, followed by recovery after HTTP cancellation, HTTP 400, and a new reference. Allocator reservation plateaued at 1840MiB before periodic cleanup at request 16; not a long-term leak proof.

options_compared.option: Reference embedding reuse and CUDA allocator reuse
options_compared.reason: Measured repeated SV embedding and full GC/empty_cache costs. Retain identical inference/segmentation/sampling with one cached reference and periodic/error cleanup.

Measured first-inference initialization of reference processing, Japanese frontend and CUDA kernels. Run a local short inference before readiness; explicitly report its extra startup cost. No playback or cloud service.

Mode 2 warm median first PCM approximately 0.525s; mode 3 approximately 0.233s. Official API labels mode 2 medium quality and mode 3 lower quality. Mode 3 also changed total PCM duration from 5.52s to 4.829s in this sample.

options_compared.option: Earlier sentence submission / less playback prebuffer
options_compared.reason: Already submits completed Japanese before translation completion, uses concurrent bounded LLM/TTS/playback queues, and buffers only 60ms. Preserve these existing behaviors.

limitations: GPU clock, background processes, filesystem caches and small sample counts affect timing. Do not extrapolate these medians to RTX 50-series hardware.
Startup warmup shifts initialization work earlier; fresh-process total readiness was 31.859s before versus 35.256s after, including 2.816s warmup. It does not eliminate model load time.

Subjective mechanical sound and voice quality were not evaluated with blind listening; model, speed, quality mode and sampling settings were retained. Waveforms were not bit-identical even between baseline repeats.
Single-reference embedding cache intentionally retains only one tensor; switching references recomputes embedding. Warmup uses the existing neutral reference, not every expression.
Mode 1 still waits for synthesis of a complete server-side text segment. Long unpunctuated Japanese can have higher first-audio latency.
Every 16 successful requests performs full GC and allocator cleanup; errors and interrupted generators force full cleanup.
Existing external service on port 9880 was kept running; restart the existing TachiTalk app/service for new code to take effect.

tests.baseline: 228 tests; one desktop visibility failure. Isolated desktop retry: 5 passed. No unrelated UI fix.
tests.final: 241 tests passed in 233.911s; unittest discover -s tests -v, project .venv, no skips.
tests.targeted: Cache 6 passed; TTS lifecycle/device/warmup 18 passed; pipeline 10 passed; API integration 14 passed.

review.correctness: Traced pipeline generate/synthesize/player callbacks, SpeechServices, API generator exhaustion, startup readiness and owned-process close. Regression and real local recovery checks passed.
review.readability: Changes restricted to reference reuse, success/error cleanup policy, startup warmup, stage timing and standalone measurement script.
review.architecture: Existing mode-1 inference, bounded queues, cancellation task group, 60ms prebuffer, per-turn voice expression lock and per-part portrait events retained.
review.security: No dependency, key storage or authenticated endpoint changes. Warmup is configured only through the owned process environment and remains local; no cloud calls or microphone.
review.performance: Controlled fixed-text medians plus cold first-play trial and per-stage synchronized profile captured. Extra startup warmup cost and device/acoustic measurement limits explicit.
